verified_observations: REDstore operates as an online electronics shop in Armenia with categories including Smartphones, Tablets, Watches, Notebooks, Computers, Monitors, TV, Game Consoles, Photo & video recorders, Audio Equipment, Projectors, Drones, Scooters, Small and Large Home Appliances, Beauty and care.
Product pricing is displayed in Armenian Dram (AMD) with installment options shown as monthly payments over 48 months (e.g., iPhone 18 Pro 256GB at 569,000 AMD = 12,480 AMD/month).
Site supports multiple languages (EN, AM, RU) and currencies (AMD, USD, EUR, RUB), and promotes a REDstore mobile app for shopping with fast delivery.
